# Nishika Sindhwani — Software Engineer

> Nishika Sindhwani is a software engineer in New Delhi.
> She builds full-stack products and practical AI.
> Most of the work sits in backend systems, application architecture, and machine learning that has to live inside a real product.

## Who

Nishika is studying B.Tech Computer Science Engineering at Guru Tegh Bahadur 4th Century Engineering College, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University. Expected graduation is 2027.

She likes to understand a system before changing it. The interesting problems are usually in the architecture, the data, and whether people actually use what ships.

## Work

In 2025 she joined LabBuddy, a healthcare marketplace, first on the frontend and then across the stack. The internship used Next.js, React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, FastAPI, Python, and MySQL. The product is in production and serves more than 5,000 users.

## Projects

1. Shotkut — an AI stock footage platform. Current work is semantic search and video editing, with FastAPI, Node.js, MongoDB, Pinecone, S3, and OpenAI.
2. Misinformation detection — language models, retrieval, OCR, and embeddings. FastAPI, Python, and MongoDB.
3. SoulNest — commerce software on Next.js, FastAPI, React, TypeScript, MySQL, and Redux Toolkit.
4. LabBuddy — the healthcare marketplace above.
5. SatQuery — remote sensing with AI.

## Stack

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Redux Toolkit, MySQL, MongoDB, Git.
Applied work uses OpenAI, embeddings, retrieval, Pinecone, and OCR.
